summaries: A Form 10-K Annual Report for BoxScore Brands, Inc. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2019. Relevant to the task: This document provides the share capital baseline immediately preceding the requested 2020–2024 trend period. It discloses 37,717,755 common shares outstanding as of December 31, 2019 (up from 32,176,659 in 2018) and 600 million authorized shares. While the company was named BoxScore Brands, Inc. at this time, this filing serves as the historical anchor for the entity that later became American Battery Materials, Inc., providing the pre-2020 data point necessary for continuity, though it does not contain specific share capital figures for the years 2020 through 2024.

A Form 10-K Annual Report for BoxScore Brands, Inc. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2020. Relevant to the task: The document provides the share capital data for 2020, serving as the initial data point for the American Battery Materials, Inc. trend analysis (BoxScore Brands amended its name to American Battery Materials, Inc. in October 2022 per collection context). It reports 75,828,064 shares of common stock issued and outstanding as of December 31, 2020, up from 37,717,755 shares at December 31, 2019. The increase was driven by 38,110,309 shares issued from the conversion of convertible notes. The document contains no financial data for the years 2021 through 2024, limiting its scope to the beginning of the requested period.

A Form 10-K Annual Report for BoxScore Brands, Inc. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2021. Relevant to the task: The document provides audited share capital data for BoxScore Brands, Inc., which is the predecessor entity to American Battery Materials. It confirms 75,828,064 common shares outstanding as of December 31, 2020, and reports an increase to 335,778,778 shares as of December 31, 2021. The growth of 259,950,714 shares during the year was primarily driven by the conversion of convertible notes and accrued interest into common stock. Authorized shares stood at 600,000,000 during this period. This filing supplies the verified 2021 data point required for the trend analysis, though it does not cover the 2022 name change, the 2023 reverse stock split, or 2024 figures found in subsequent documents.

A Form 10-K Annual Report for BoxScore Brands, Inc. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2022. Relevant to the task: This document establishes the corporate identity continuity between BoxScore Brands, Inc. and American Battery Materials, Inc., noting the name change effective October 20, 2022. It provides share capital data for 2020 (75,828,064 shares), 2021 (335,778,778 shares), and 2022 (3,245,556,528 shares), as well as an outstanding share count snapshot as of April 19, 2023 (3,319,240,740). These figures represent the unadjusted share counts prior to the 2023 reverse stock split referenced in other filings. It also discloses an authorized share increase from 600 million to 4.5 billion shares effective October 2022 and authorizes potential future share reductions or splits.

A Form 10-K Annual Report for American Battery Materials, Inc. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023. Relevant to the task: This document provides the 2023 data point to complete the 2020–2024 share capital trend. It reports 11,373,793 common shares issued and outstanding as of December 31, 2023, compared to 10,818,522 shares as of December 31, 2022. The filing discloses a 1-for-300 reverse stock split effective December 8, 2023, noting that share counts in the comparative financial statements are retroactively restated to reflect this split. It also reports 11,375,459 shares outstanding as of April 1, 2024. Historical data for 2020 and 2021 is not contained herein.
